companyIntro.name: People First Partners
companyIntro.mission: Make hiring, pay and employee relations fair, compliant and efficient.
companyIntro.culture: Fair process, accurate records. People decisions are documented and explainable.

projectBackground.name: Graduate Hiring Programme
projectBackground.context: Roles are taking too long to fill and good candidates decline. The client wants a fix without lowering standards.

manager.name: Agnieszka Nowak
manager.role: Head of Talent, People First Partners
manager.note: Speed and fairness aren't opposites. Show me the funnel and how you keep it consistent.

assignment.title: Speed up hiring fairly
assignment.brief: Calculate hiring metrics, choose interview methods, reduce bias and write a candidate message.

documents.name: Time-to-Hire
documents.note: Three recent hires took 30, 42 and 36 days.

tasks.title: Average Time-to-Hire
tasks.prompt: Hires took 30, 42 and 36 days. What is the average?
tasks.mistake: Using the longest case only skews the picture.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Offer Acceptance Rate

tasks.title: Candidate Message
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence rejection message that is respectful and useful.
tasks.modelAnswer: Thank you for taking the time to interview for the graduate analyst role. After careful comparison against the role criteria we have decided to move forward with another candidate. Your case presentation was a clear strength, and if you'd like, I can share brief feedback on the areas we'd suggest developing. We will keep your details with your permission for future roles.
tasks.reasoning: A good message is timely, respectful and offers feedback.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Candidate Who Never Heard Back
caseStudy.background: A company left finalists waiting three weeks with no message. Half withdrew and several posted negative reviews.
caseStudy.solution: People First introduced a 48-hour update standard.

prompts: Which metric would you fix first?
How do you keep interviews fair?
